claims: Deep learning is a subset of machine learning using multi-layered artificial neural networks (deep neural networks).
Deep learning analyzes complex, unstructured data like images, text, and audio.
Deep learning mimics the human brain's structure.
Deep learning autonomously learns representations and patterns.
Neural networks are composed of input, hidden, and output layers.
Neural networks process data in layers.
The "deep" refers to numerous hidden layers.
Deep learning models learn directly from raw data.
Deep learning eliminates the need for manual feature extraction.
Deep learning uses vast datasets to refine algorithms via forward and backward propagation.
Deep learning relies on high-performance GPUs to process simultaneous calculations.
CNNs are specialized in computer vision.
CNNs are specialized in image recognition.
RNNs are utilized for sequential data like text or speech.
RNNs use feedback loops.
LSTM is a type of RNN.
LSTM is designed to recognize long-term dependencies in data.
GANs are used to generate new, synthetic data.
GANs work by having two networks compete.
Transformers are used to process sequential data.
Transformers power modern large language models like GPT.
Deep learning requires massive, high-quality labeled datasets to perform well.
Deep learning demands high-performance hardware (GPUs) for training.
Deep learning is used for unlocking phones.
Deep learning is used for social media tagging.
Deep learning is used for medical diagnostic imaging.
Deep learning powers translation services.
Deep learning powers voice assistants (Siri, Alexa).
Deep learning powers chatbots.
Deep learning enables self-driving cars to navigate.
Deep learning enables robotic systems to function.
Deep learning detects fraud in finance.
Deep learning monitors real-time trading in finance.
